title: Non-record submission: CE + Embedding Aware Loss + Uniformity Loss
author: sttawm

data.description: Auxiliary embedding-aware loss added to cross-entropy; predicted embedding is the softmax-weighted average of token embeddings and is compared to the ground-truth embedding with cosine similarity.
Experiments were mostly run with untied embeddings; tied embeddings are mentioned as a comparison point.

novel_contributions: Introduces an embedding-aware auxiliary loss based on cosine similarity between predicted and ground-truth token embeddings.
Shows that the embedding-only objective can correlate with cross-entropy early in training, but collapses without additional constraints.
Adds a uniformity loss to prevent embedding-space collapse and preserve the embedding-loss signal.
Evaluates combining cross-entropy with embedding-aware and uniformity losses, finding no significant improvement over baseline.
